plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's dreams. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: When they do, the relationship can become a source of quiet inspiration. The Neptune person helps the Sun person trust their imagination. The Sun person helps the Neptune person bring their visions into the world. What is dreamed can become lived. The challenge is subtle. It is easy to enjoy the feeling of possibility without ever asking where it is leading. Plans can remain ideas. Feelings can remain implied. Both people may assume they understand each other without taking the time to make things clear.
advice: The point is not to abandon the dream. It is to give it a place to land. This aspect is at its best when inspiration is paired with honesty, when kindness is paired with clarity, and when both people allow themselves to be seen not only for who they could become, but for who they already are.
summaryShort: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism.
